query: MATCH (sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber IN ['38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215'] WITH DISTINCT sp.specNumber AS ts OPTIONAL MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Spec {specNumber:ts}) WITH ts,count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCnt OPTIONAL MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Spec {specNumber:ts}) RETURN ts,crCnt,count(DISTINCT agr) AS agrCnt
